name: Controlled self-sustaining nuclear chain reaction
summary: In December 1942 a reactor in Chicago sustained and controlled a nuclear chain reaction, opening the way to nuclear power and weapons.
description: A reactor system demonstrated a controlled self-sustaining nuclear chain reaction in Chicago in December 1942.
tier_reason: Controlled reaction systems support subsequent reactor engineering, scientific reactors and nuclear-energy development over generations.

impact.note: A new energy source and capability; power reactors, weapons, naval propulsion, isotope medicine and neutron science across many societies all rest on it.

why: After fission was discovered, wartime fear of a German atomic bomb drove the United States to prove a chain reaction could be sustained.
